items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: I played with him for years and years too, Johnny Hande, the saxophone player.

ctx.x: Oh, mostly, mostly. Yeah. They could read, but you mostly played jazz. I see. Yeah, I see, because they used to think like George McCollum, he was an Indian-Oman musician. Yeah, he was a sight reader.

Yeah. And this fellow Johnny Hande, I played with him for years and years too, Johnny Hande, the saxophone player. He told me about you. He's Johnny Hande? He's playing, yeah. He's playing with me two or three nights a week, Johnny Hande.
But for the first time I ever played here, I played with you, I don't know.
